lines.beaver: 이거 가족 사진이에요? 와, 가족이 많네요!
lines.beaver_en: Is this your family photo? Wow, you have a big family!
lines.beaver_roman: igeo gajok sajinieyo? wa, gajogi manneyo!
lines.learner: 네, 우리 가족이에요. 모두 열 명이에요.
lines.en: Yes, it's my family. There are ten of us.
lines.roman: ne, uri gajogieyo. modu yeol myeongieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are these your grandfather and grandmother?
Are these your father and mother?
lines.learner: 네, 우리 부모님이에요. 그 옆은 오빠예요.
lines.en: Yes, my parents. Next to them is my older brother.
lines.roman: ne, uri bumonimieyo. geu yeopeun oppayeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Who is this baby? So cute!
lines.learner: 언니 딸이에요. 언니 옆은 언니 남편이에요.
lines.en: My older sister's daughter. Next to her is her husband.
lines.roman: eonni ttarieyo. eonni yeopeun eonni nampyeonieyo.

lines.en: She's two. Her name is Hana.

lines.beaver_en: Then is this your younger sibling?
lines.learner: 네, 제 여동생이에요. 저는 그 옆에 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, my younger sister. I'm next to her.
lines.roman: ne, je yeodongsaengieyo. jeoneun geu yeope isseoyo.

lines.learner: 시월 삼 일이에요. 이번 주 토요일이에요.
lines.roman: siwol sam irieyo. ibeon ju toyoirieyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 얼마 안 남았네요! 생일 파티해요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, it's coming up soon! Having a birthday party?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, eolma an namanneyo! saengil patihaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 토요일에 가족이 다 같이 만나요.
lines.en: Yes, the whole family meets on Saturday.
lines.roman: ne, toyoire gajogi da gachi mannayo.

lines.beaver_en: Does your whole family live together?
lines.learner: 언니 가족도 우리 집에 같이 살아요.
lines.en: My older sister's family lives with us too.
lines.roman: eonni gajokdo uri jibe gachi sarayo.

lines.beaver_en: A big family! I only have an older sister and brother.
lines.learner: 다음에 누나, 형 사진도 보여 주세요!
lines.en: Show me their photos next time!
lines.roman: daeume nuna, hyeong sajindo boyeo juseyo!
